title: Digital Marketing Agency in Birmingham, AL
metaTitle: Digital Marketing Agency in Birmingham, AL | TDM
metaDescription: Digital marketing for Birmingham, Alabama businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video for medical, financial, construction and local firms.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Birmingham businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Birmingham grew up as a steel town and now runs on medicine, banking, insurance and construction, with customers spread across dozens of separate suburbs on both sides of Red Mountain. We build marketing around the part of the metro you serve and the people who decide there.

sections.heading: From iron and steel to medicine and finance
paragraphs: The furnaces that gave Birmingham its start are now landmarks, and the University of Alabama at Birmingham has taken their place as the engine of the city. UAB and its hospital are among the largest employers in Alabama, and around them sit other hospital systems, specialist practices, research groups and medical suppliers. Patients travel in from across the state for care.

Birmingham is also a financial centre for the region, home to a major bank headquarters and to insurers, law firms and wealth managers. Large construction and engineering companies are based here, and a start-up community has formed around the Innovation Depot downtown.

For marketing, that means two kinds of work. Medical, legal and financial firms compete on trust, so they need accurate, detailed pages for each service and a record of reviews. Contractors and business suppliers sell to other companies and need project pages and search visibility for specific capabilities.

sections.heading: A metro made of many towns
paragraphs: Greater Birmingham is not one municipality. Homewood, Mountain Brook, Vestavia Hills and Hoover lie south of Red Mountain, an area locals call "over the mountain". Trussville is to the east, and Pelham, Alabaster and Chelsea stretch down into Shelby County. Inside the city, Southside and Five Points South, Avondale, Lakeview and Uptown each have their own restaurants, bars and shops, and the Highway 280 corridor carries a long line of offices and retail.

People search with these names. Someone in Hoover looks for a dentist in Hoover, not in Birmingham. A business with one location and customers across the metro will only show up widely if its site and profile say where it works.
bullets: Area pages for the suburbs you actually serve, named as residents name them.
A complete Google Business Profile for each physical location, with the service area set correctly.
Ad targeting drawn around real travel patterns, including the 280 and Interstate 65 commutes.
A simple routine for asking satisfied customers for reviews.
Call and form tracking, so you know which area and which campaign produced the work.

sections.heading: Food, history and events
paragraphs: Birmingham has a restaurant scene that draws national attention, from long-established fine dining to barbecue and the breweries of Avondale. Restaurants here are chosen from photos, short video and map listings, so content has to be kept fresh.

The Civil Rights District, including the Birmingham Civil Rights Institute and 16th Street Baptist Church, brings visitors and school groups through the year. Motorsport weekends at Barber Motorsports Park and football at Protective Stadium and Legion Field fill hotels, and autumn Saturdays change shopping and dining patterns across the city whenever Alabama or Auburn plays. We build these dates into content calendars and ad schedules.

presence: TDM works with Birmingham businesses remotely. We do not have an office or staff in the city. Work is delivered online by one team, with scheduled video calls and written reports.

faqs.q: Is TDM based in Birmingham, Alabama?
faqs.a: No. We work with Birmingham businesses remotely. You deal with the same team throughout, by video call and shared reporting.

faqs.q: How do I show up in searches from Hoover, Homewood or Vestavia Hills?
faqs.a: Give each area its own page describing the work you do there, set your service area properly in your Google Business Profile, and collect reviews from customers in those suburbs. If you have more than one location, each needs its own profile.

faqs.q: What does a marketing agency cost in Birmingham?
faqs.a: The price depends on the scope of work: the channels involved, the amount of content and the competition in your field. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: Can you market a medical practice near UAB?
faqs.a: Yes. We write clear pages for each service and provider, manage local listings and reviews, and run ads worded to meet the advertising platforms' health policies. Any clinical claims are checked with you before they are published.

faqs.q: How long before I see results?
faqs.a: That depends on your requirements and the brief. Paid campaigns and SEO move at different speeds, and the timeline for each is agreed in the plan.
